note: The script asks for five graphics: the hook text, Kerri's name super, her key words in two groups and “thrive” alone. The super shows “Kerri Colfer” only, because the one-line tag cannot hold her full title “Director of Policy and Research, NIWRC” and NIWRC wants titles exactly as given, never shortened.

mg.title: Safety starts with policy
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “SAFETY STARTS WITH POLICY.” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Hook text, already on screen at 0:00. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:07.

mg.title: Kerri name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:07, lower left, 2 seconds: “Kerri Colfer” / “Director of Policy and Research, NIWRC”.
mg.use: Name super at 00:07 for 2 seconds. Move it lower left, above the captions.

mg.title: Policy key words
mg.cue: Then key words as she says them: “policy-driven data” · “policy change”.
mg.use: Start it when she says “policy-driven data”, after the name super. Hold the frame after the first words come in, then let “policy change” come in when she says it.

mg.title: Conditions key words
mg.cue: Key words as she says them: “stable housing” · “economic security” · “culturally tailored services”.
mg.use: Start it when she says “stable housing”. Hold the frame between the words so each one comes in as she says it.

mg.title: Thrive alone
mg.use: Put it on her word “thrive”, alone, and hold it through the 1 second on her face after it.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026. Client rule: white logo on red.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:32 after the last line and hold it to the end.
